name: gabis-job-hunter
description: Gabis Job Hunter: finds matching roles on company career sites and LinkedIn, writes calm, true one-page cover letters, fills and submits applications after your approval, and keeps a tracker plus one folder per application. A small agent team (job crawlers, posting gaters, approval desk, letter reviewer, company researchers) does the fan-out work on models chosen by a cost-quality frontier. Set up once from your CV, then say "find me jobs".
